u0: Normal progress with no pending fall recovery: move toward the exit and make sure you are holding the box when you step onto it. If you are empty-handed only because you voluntarily put the box down after an earlier fall, retrieve it before exiting. If the box falls, you enter u1 and must pick it up on the very next action; reaching the exit while holding it yields u3.
u1: The box has just fallen and is not in your hands. This is the one-step recovery window: your immediate next action must pick it up. A successful pickup returns you to normal progress in u0, or directly to success u3 if the exit is reached while holding it; failing to hold the box after this step enters the irreversible failure state u2.
u2: Failure state: the box fell and was not picked up on the immediately following step. The recovery requirement has been missed permanently; this state is absorbing and cannot reach the successful exit condition, regardless of later actions.
u3: Success terminal: you reached the exit while holding the box, with every fall recovered immediately. The task is complete and there is no further objective.
